fact: The World Bank ISR for the RISE project records no interoperability across the GamSR, the education management information systems, CRVS and the health insurance system at baseline (January 2024) and a current value of 0 at 25 November 2025, against a target of at least 3 systems interoperable by October 2028; one instance is being verified.
system: Interoperability of the GamSR, EMISs (MoBSE and MoHERST), CRVS and health insurance system
